## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Related issue

Link the issue, if any.

## Verification

List checks run and their results.
Explain any check you could not run.
For application changes, include the relevant Ruff, compile, and pytest results.

## Review notes

Describe behavior changes, migrations, and known limits.
Call out API contract, environment, or deployment changes.
Remove sensitive information from screenshots and logs.
